items.name: Qwen-Audio-3.1
items.plain: Voice AI that can listen and speak in many more languages, helping clients serve customers in their own language without building separate systems.
items.summary: Alibaba's Qwen team expanded its hosted Qwen-Audio-3.1 voice models on November 26, with speech recognition now covering 59 languages, text-to-speech 65 languages and realtime conversation 53 languages. The update broadens multilingual voice support for production ASR, TTS and realtime endpoints.

items.name: Mellum 2.1 Instruct
items.plain: A fast, open coding assistant for small fixes and routine developer tasks that clients can run on their own infrastructure.
items.summary: JetBrains released Mellum 2.1 Instruct on November 26, an open-weight coding model under Apache 2.0 that gives direct answers without chain-of-thought. It is built for coding sub-agents, tool loops and chat, generating about half as many tokens as its Thinking sibling.

items.name: Raon-1 mini
items.plain: An open model for conversation and agent work that clients can download, adapt and run themselves instead of relying only on a hosted service.
items.summary: KRAFTON AI released the full version of Raon-1 mini, an open-weight model trained from scratch and released under Apache 2.0 on Hugging Face. It is designed for Korean conversation and agentic tasks, with selectable reasoning effort levels.

items.name: Kolibri 1.1
items.plain: A German and English business assistant that clients in Europe can self-host, keeping sensitive work inside their own environment.
items.summary: Aleph Alpha released Kolibri 1.1, an open-weight reasoning model specialised for German and English under Apache 2.0. It succeeds Kolibri 1.0 with a focus on efficient inference, multi-step reasoning, retrieval and agentic tool calling.

items.name: Sarvam-105B-1711
items.plain: An open model for high-volume support and voice agents in Indian languages that clients can run on their own premises for privacy.
items.summary: Sarvam AI released Sarvam-105B-1711 on November 22, a new open-weight checkpoint built for high-volume customer support, voice agents and agentic tasks. Sarvam says it improves instruction following, tool calling and Indian-language handling over its February release.
